blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
An LLM agent’s capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model.
Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks.
We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses ( RRSI ), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection.
The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises.
Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. github.com/google-research/rrsi regularized-rsi.com

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern LLM agents are systems rather than standalone models ( Rajasekaran, 2026 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) . A frozen backbone model is wrapped in a harness of prompts, control flow, tool interfaces, memory and context management. Agent harness decides whether the same model reads the right file before editing it, recovers from a failed command, manages efficient working context, and writes its findings into the deliverables. Much recent progress in agent products came from harness engineering rather than from new model weights ( Weng, 2026 ; Zhang and Khattab, 2026 ; Karten et al., 2026a ) . However, this engineering relies on manual efforts, where humans inspect failed trajectories and tweak the scaffold by hand, so progress is limited by how many trajectories an engineer can read.
blocks.zh: 现代LLM剂是系统而不是独立的模型(Rajasekaran,2026;Lopopolo,2026). 一个被冻结的骨干模型被捆绑在一种由导线,控制流,工具界面,内存和上下文管理等组成的操纵器中. Agent jap 决定同一模型在编辑之前是否读取正确的文件,从失败的命令中恢复,管理高效的工作环境,并将其结论写入可交付文件. 近期在代理产品上的进展大多来自利用工程,而不是新的模型重量(Weng, 2026;Zhang and Khattab, 2026;Karten等人, 2026a)。 然而,这一工程依赖于人工努力,人类在那里检查故障的轨迹并用手对脚手架进行修饰,因此进展受到工程师能读到多少轨迹的限制.

blocks.en: Recent methods automate this loop by using LLMs to optimize harness components from task feedback ( Lou et al., 2026 ; Niklaus, 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Karten et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) . Such iterative harness evolution provides a practical form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Team et al., 2026 ; RSI-Exam Team, 2026 ) at the agent-system level, where feedback from the current system is used to improve the harness that shapes its subsequent behavior. However, as illustrated in Figure 1 (a), test-time harness evolution repeatedly proposes and selects edits using feedback from a finite evolve set, creating an adaptive overfitting risk: evolve-set performance may improve without corresponding gains on unseen tasks. Recent studies observe substantial gaps between evolution and held-out performance, and show that apparent improvements can arise from task-specific fitting or increased test-time computation rather than reusable mechanisms ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ) . Accordingly, recent works explicitly separate evolution and evaluation tasks to measure generalization ( Huang et al., 2026d ; Ke et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) . We therefore study the generalization problem in recursive self-improvement, which is defined as evolved harness transferring to unseen benchmarks with different task descriptions, tool interfaces, or verifiers.
blocks.zh: 近期的方法通过使用LLMS来优化任务反馈的利用组件,实现这一循环的自动化(Lou等人,2026年;Niklaus等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年b;Lin等人,2026年a;张等人,2026年a;Nie等人,2026年a;Lee等人,2026年a;陈等人,2026年b;Karten等人,2026年b;张等人,2026年e). 这种迭代拉带演化提供了一种在代理系统层面的递归自我改进(RSI)(Wang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年b;Team等人,2026年;RSI-Exam Team,2026年)的实用形式,其中利用了当前系统的反馈来改进塑造其后续行为的拉带. 然而,如图1(a)所示,试验时间的利用演化反复提出并选择使用来自有限演化集的反馈进行编辑,从而形成适应性过强的风险:演化设定的性能可能改善,而未见任务的相应收益。 最近的研究发现演化与停产业绩之间存在巨大差距,并表明,具体任务的适应性或增加测试时间的计算,而不是重复使用的机制,可以产生明显的改进(Wang等人,2026b); Ding等人,2026;Lin等人,2026b.). 因此,最近的工作明确将演变和评价任务分开,以衡量普遍性(Huang等人,2026d; Ke等,2026;张等,2026d). 因此,我们研究了递归自我改进中的一般化问题,这种改进的定义是,通过不同的任务说明、工具界面或核查器,向无形基准转移进化的利用。

blocks.en: Our study shows that overfitting can arise through several coupled behaviors ( Zhang et al., 2026d ; Yang et al., 2026a ) . The evolution search may encode benchmark-specific patterns, promote candidates favored by the evaluation noise, or accumulate complexity that improves evolve-set scores without improving the underlying agent mechanism. These benchmark-specific fitting , noise chasing , and complexity accumulation all widen the evolve-to-transfer gap. Inspired by these observations, our solution regularizes how recursive harness improvements use finite and noisy feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究表明,过度适应可能通过几种偶联行为产生(张等人,2026d;杨等人,2026a). 进化搜索可能编码特定基准模式,促进受评价噪音青睐的候选人,或者积累复杂度,改善进化设定的分数,而不改进基本的代理机制. 这些针对具体基准的装配、追逐噪音和复杂性的积累都扩大了向转移的鸿沟。 受这些观察的启发,我们的解决方案规范了循环利用改进如何使用有限和吵闹的反馈。

blocks.en: We introduce RRSI , a framework for regularizing the RSI of agent harness that keeps the harness fully editable while constraining how finite evolve-set feedback guides the search. As illustrated in Figure 2, RRSI regularizes both sides of the evolution loop: it encourages simpler and more reusable edits when proposing candidates, and applies robust selection criteria to avoid retaining improvements driven by benchmark-specific signals, evaluation noise, or unnecessary complexity. In this way, RRSI favors edits that transfer beyond evolution set without restricting which harness components may be updated.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了RRSI, 用于规范代理绳索的RSI的框架, 如图2所示,RRSI规范了进化循环的两面:它鼓励在推荐候选人时进行更简单,更可重复使用的编辑,并采用强健的甄选标准,以避免保留由具体基准信号,评价噪音或不必要的复杂性驱动的改进. 这样,RRSI倾向于编辑超越进化设定的传输而不限制哪些控制组件可以更新.

blocks.en: We evaluate RRSI on eight benchmarks spanning three domains that differ in task type, tooling and verifier. In each domain the harness is evolved on a single suite, and is then run unchanged on held-out benchmarks. As shown in Figure 1 (b–d), it gains up to 14.1 points on the evolving split and improves all six held-out splits, by up to 4.7 points out of distribution, on fewer policy tokens than unregularized evolution spends. More importantly, these gains generalize beyond the environment used for evolution. RRSI retains its improvements across substantially different tasks and evaluation settings, indicating that it learns broadly useful harness changes. More importantly, RRSI generalizes across held-out environments, outperforming the average prior baseline by up to 22.9%.
blocks.zh: 我们根据涉及三个领域、任务类型、工具和核查方法各不相同的8项基准,对区域资源统计数据库进行评价。 在每一个领域,牵引装置都是在一个单一的套间上演化的,然后按搁置的基准运行。 如图1(b-d)所示,在不断演变的分裂中,增长最高可达14.1分,并且将所有6个搁置的分裂从分配中扣除4.7分,与非正规化演变的开支相比,政策标志减少。 更重要的是,这些收益超越了用于进化的环境。 RRSI保留了它在实质性不同的任务和评价环境方面的改进,表明它学习了广泛的有用利用变化。 更重要的是,RRSI将整个被搁置的环境概括起来,比上一个平均基准高出22.9%。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) We identify the overfitting as a key challenge in harness-based recursive self-improvement. (2) We propose RRSI , which regularizes both proposal and selection during harness evolution while keeping each harness component editable. (3) Across eight benchmarks in three domains, RRSI improves both transfer and efficiency, showing the effectiveness of our proposed approach.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: (1) 我们确定,过度适应是基于利用的递归自我改进的关键挑战。 (2) 我们提议RRSI,它使提案和选择在利用演化过程中规范化,同时使每个利用组件可以编辑。 (3) 在三个领域的八项基准中,区域资源统计倡议既改善了转让,也提高了效率,显示了我们拟议办法的有效性。

blocks.en: 3 RRSI
blocks.zh: 3个RRSI

blocks.en: We study RSI through iterative harness evolution, where feedback from the current agent system is repeatedly used to propose and select modifications to the harness. RRSI follows this recursive improvement process and keeps the harness edit space open, but regularizes how the evolution moves through that space. The key idea is to translate regularization principles from machine learning into an adaptive harness search: sparse updates limit how many mechanisms can change in response to one round of feedback, evidence-aware credit assignment prevents the search from repeatedly spending its capacity on hypotheses it has already falsified, and conservative selection prevents leakage, evaluation noise, or unjustified resource growth from becoming permanent harness state.
blocks.zh: 我们通过迭代的牵引进化研究RSI,从当前代理系统的反馈被反复用于提议和选择牵引的修改. RRSI遵循了这种递归性的改进过程,并保持了拉带编辑空间的开放性,但将演化如何穿过该空间进行规范化. 关键的想法是将正规化原则从机器学习转化为适应性化的带带搜索:零星更新限制了多少机制可以因一回合反馈而改变,有证据意识的信用分配阻止了搜索在已经伪造的假说上反复花费其能力,保守的选择防止渗漏,评价噪音或不合理的资源增长成为永久性带态.

blocks.en: 3.1 A Regularization View of Harness Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.1 合理性演变的规范化视图

blocks.en: Let Ω ⁡ ( H ) \Omega(H) denote the set of harnesses reachable from H H by arbitrary source edits. RRSI deliberately leaves Ω ⁡ ( H ) \Omega(H) open: prompts, control flow, configuration, context management, tools, skills, memory, and subagents may all be modified, added, or removed. Instead of restricting this hypothesis space directly, we regularize the search trajectory through it. At each round t t , the proposer uses feedback from the finite evolve set to generate candidate edits to the current harness H t H_{t} , and the selector determines which, if any, should replace the incumbent.
blocks.zh: 让组合 QQ (H )\ Omega (H) 通过任意的源编辑来匹配从 H H 到达的组合 。 RRSI 刻意将组合 QQ (H)\Omega (H) 打开: 提示、 控制流、 配置、 上下文管理、 工具、 技能、 内存和子代理都可能被修改、 添加或删除 。 而不是直接限制这个假说空间, 我们规范搜索轨迹通过它。 在每回合 t t 时, 提议者使用来自有限进化集的反馈来生成候选人编辑到当前 jap H t H_{t} , 选择者决定哪个(如果有的话)应该替换现任者.

blocks.en: This view separates two complementary forms of regularization. On the proposal side, we constrain how much adaptive capacity can be exercised in a single round and where that capacity is spent. On the selection side, we constrain which empirical improvements are strong enough, efficient enough, and sufficiently free of leakage to survive. Our complexity control framework takes inspiration from three classical regularization approaches ( Hastie et al., 2009 ; Goodfellow et al., 2016 ; Louizos et al., 2018 ) , and we explain the analogy below. The edit budget is the closest to an L 0 L_{0} -style cardinality constraint as it directly limits the number of independently active edits in an update. Structural pruning is analogous to Lasso/ L 1 L_{1} -style sparsification because persistently unproductive components are removed from the retained harness, producing a sparser structure. Complexity-aware acceptance is analogous to Ridge/ L 2 L_{2} -style shrinkage since it suppresses unchecked growth in the aggregate resource footprint without requiring any particular component to be eliminated. Detailed algorithm description can be found in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 这一观点将两种互补形式的正规化区分开来. 在提议方面,我们限制在单一回合中行使多少适应能力,限制这种能力在哪里使用。 在选择方面,我们制约着经验上的改进,这些改进足够强大,足够高效,足够避免渗漏而生存。 我们的复杂性控制框架从三种古典规范化方法(Hattie等人,2009年;Goodfellow等人,2016年;Louizos等人,2018年)中得到启发,我们解释如下类比. 编辑预算最接近 L0 L_{0} - 样式主控约束,因为它直接限制更新中独立活动编辑的次数。 结构修剪类似于拉索/L 1 L_{1} - 风格的斯巴塞化,因为持续无效益的部件被从保留带中移除,产生较稀疏的结构。 复杂感知接受类似于Ridge/L 2 L_{2} - 类型收缩,因为它抑制了总资源足迹的无节制增长,而不需要消除任何特定的组成部分。 详细的算法描述参见附录C.

blocks.en: 3.2 Regularizing the Proposal Distribution
blocks.zh: 3.2 使提案分配正规化

blocks.en: The proposal distribution determines how aggressively the search can respond to feedback from the evolve set. RRSI regularizes it in three ways: it anneals how much update capacity a single round may exercise, it makes credit assignment evidence-aware over the whole run, and it structures where that capacity is spent.
blocks.zh: 提案的分发决定了搜索能够如何积极响应从演进的集中的反馈. RRSI以三种方式使它正规化:它否定了每轮一次可进行多少更新的能力;它使信贷转让在整个过程中都认识到证据;它构建了使用这种能力的地点。

blocks.en:
An unconstrained proposer can bundle many unrelated modifications into one candidate. Such candidates have high effective capacity: they can fit more idiosyncrasies of the current feedback, and any measured change is difficult to attribute to a particular mechanism. We therefore cap the number of independently attributable edits that may be included in one proposal. At round t t of a T T -round run, this budget is b t = ⌈ b min + ( b max − b min ) ⋅ 1 2 ​ ( 1 + cos ⁡ ( π ​ t / T ) ) ⌉ . b_{t}=\Big\lceil b_{\min}+(b_{\max}-b_{\min})\cdot\tfrac{1}{2}\big(1+\cos(\pi t/T)\big)\Big\rceil. (4) The schedule decreases from b max b_{\max} to b min b_{\min} : early rounds may combine several coordinated changes to discover new mechanisms, whereas later rounds become increasingly sparse and attributable.
This is our most direct classical analogy: if the independently attributable edits in a candidate are represented by binary activity indicators, the budget bounds their cardinality, i.e., an L 0 L_{0} -style constraint on the update. The analogy applies to update sparsity rather than to a fixed model parameter vector; the edit pool can change across rounds, and we do not optimize an L 0 L_{0} -penalized objective.

blocks.en: Constraining the size of an update only helps if the search knows what earlier updates established. Every evaluation is another adaptive look at the same finite evolve set, so repeatedly testing hypotheses that earlier rounds already falsified spends search capacity without adding useful evidence ( Dwork et al., 2015 ) . RRSI therefore records, for every evaluated candidate, the component it modifies, the hypothesis it tests, the source diff, the resulting score and cost changes, and whether the candidate was accepted. The proposer conditions on this history in later rounds: rejected mechanisms remain negative evidence, while successful mechanisms retain explicit credit. As later rounds allow fewer edits per candidate, it becomes easier to identify which change is responsible for an observed improvement.
blocks.zh: 限制更新的大小只有在搜索知道先前已建立哪些更新时才有帮助. 每个评价都是对同一个有限进化组合的又一个适应性的观察,因此反复测试先前已经伪造的回合花费了搜索能力而不添加有用的证据的假设(Dwork等人,2015年). 因此,RRSI记录了每个被评审的候选人,其修改的成分,测试的假设,来源diff,结果的分数和成本变化,以及候选人是否被接受. 在以后几轮中,这一历史的提出者条件:被否决的机制仍然是负面证据,而成功的机制则保留明确的信用。 由于以后的几轮可以减少每个候选人的编辑,因此更容易确定哪些变化对观察到的改进负责。

blocks.en: The same history reveals when the proposer has collapsed onto a narrow edit family, for example repeatedly rewriting prompts while leaving agent structural mechanisms untouched. We treat the search as stalled when its progress over the previous w w rounds remains within the empirical noise band δ \delta . During a stall, a small portion of the proposal budget is reserved for components that have not yet been exercised in the run. This plays a role similar to diversity or entropy regularization: it redirects limited proposal capacity toward underexplored mechanisms without changing which mechanisms the harness is allowed to contain ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 同样的历史揭示了求婚者崩溃在一个狭窄的编辑家族中,例如反复重写提示同时使代理结构机制不受影响. 我们把搜索视为停滞, 当它在过去的W回合中的进展 仍然在经验噪声带 \\\ delta。 在停顿期间,拟议预算的一小部分被保留给尚未在运行中行使的构成部分。 这起作用与多样性或py规范化类似:它将有限的提议能力转向未充分探索的机制,而不改变被允许控制的机制(Haarnoja等人,2018年)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Regularizing Candidate Selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 将候选人甄选正规化

blocks.en: Standard harness evolution can promote the candidate with the largest measured score even when that score reflects explicit leakage, stochastic variation, or costly growth. RRSI retains the same empirical objective but regularizes which candidates are allowed to become permanent state. A candidate must satisfy several non-compensatory criteria before its score can justify replacing the incumbent.
blocks.zh: 标准拉带进化可以促进得分最高的候选人,即使该得分反映了明显的渗漏、扭曲变化或昂贵的增长。 RRSI保留了同样的经验目标,但将允许哪些候选人成为永久国家的标准化。 候选人必须满足若干非补偿标准,才能有理由更换现任者。

blocks.en: Before full evaluation, a critic reads each candidate diff and rejects edits that explicitly encode task names, entity names, task-specific values, answers, or other logic specific to the evolve benchmark, as well as edits that add inert machinery. The screen targets benchmark-specific content rather than particular harness components: generic prompt or tool-description improvements remain valid candidates. Screening before evaluation is important because a leaking candidate never receives the inflated evolve-set score that could make it attractive to subsequent rounds.
blocks.zh: 在完全评价前,评论家会阅读每个候选 diff 并拒绝编辑明确编码任务名称,实体名称,任务特定值,答案,或特定于进化基准的其他逻辑,以及编辑添加惰性机械. 屏幕针对的是具体基准内容,而不是特定的利用部分:通用的即时或工具描述改进仍然是有效的候选人。 在评价前进行筛选很重要,因为漏出的候选人从未获得过夸张的演化设定得分,从而能够吸引随后的几轮比赛.

blocks.en: The annealed budget in Equation ( 4 ) sparsifies each update ; pruning sparsifies the retained harness . RRSI tracks whether recently exercised components have produced a strictly positive measured gain over a fixed pruning window. Components that remain unproductive are reported to the proposer as deletion targets in subsequent rounds. This process imitates the Lasso/ L 1 L_{1} -style sparsification: mechanisms with insufficient evidence of utility are removed entirely, so the retained harness becomes structurally sparser rather than merely cheaper in aggregate. The correspondence is again qualitative, i.e., Lasso reduces the number of parameters through L 1 L_{1} regularization, whereas our pruning rule deletes discrete harness components based on their observed contribution. The shared intuition is selective sparsification: a mechanism must continue to earn its place rather than persist simply because score-only evolution has no incentive to remove it ( Hastie et al., 2009 ) .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate RRSI on eight benchmarks spanning three domains: Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Verified for coding, Harvey LAB, JobBench, GDPval and APEX-Agents for agentic workspace tasks, and EngDesign and Frontier-Eng for engineering design. Our experiments address the following questions: 1) How does RRSI compare to state-of-the-art harness evolution methods? 2) Do the gains transfer to in-distribution held-out tasks and to out-of-distribution benchmarks that the search never saw? 3) What is the contribution of different components? 4) How does the harness evolve over a run, and what does it cost in tokens?
blocks.zh: 我们根据八个涵盖三个领域的基准对RRSI进行评估:用于编码的终端-奔驰2.1和SWE-bench验证、用于代理工作空间任务的哈维LAB、Job Bench、GDPval和APEX-Agents,以及用于工程设计的EngDesign和Frontier-Eng。 我们的实验涉及以下问题: 1) RRSI如何与最先进的利用演化方法进行比较? 2) 收益是否转移到分配被搁置的任务和搜索从未看到的分配基准? (3) 不同组成部分的贡献是什么? 4) 吊带是如何在跑道上演化的,花费多少代币?

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Environments. We evolve harnesses in three types of tasks, i.e., coding tasks, agentic workspace tasks and engineering design tasks. For coding, Terminal-Bench 2.1 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) is a suite of 89 containerized terminal tasks in which the agent drives a real shell and is verified by the task’s own unit tests. For agentic workspace tasks, Harvey LAB ( Harvey AI, 2026 ) is a legal-work benchmark spanning 25 practice areas. It is split into a fixed evolve set of 120 tasks and a pristine in-distribution held-out set of 40 tasks. For engineering design, EngDesign ( Guo et al., 2025 ) contributes 61 design tasks, each graded by its own frozen simulator rather than by a judge model. To test its generalization capability, we additionally evaluate on out-of-distribution (OOD) held-out benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) for repository-level bug fixing on the coding task, JobBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) , GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) and APEX-Agents ( Vidgen et al., 2026 ) on the agentic workspace task, and Frontier-Eng ( Chi et al., 2026 ) on the engineering design task.
blocks.zh: 环境。 我们在三种任务中演化利用,即编码任务,代理工作空间任务和工程设计任务. 对于编码,终端-Bench 2.1(Merrill等人,2026年)是一个包含89个集装箱式终端任务的套件,由代理驱动一个真正的外壳,并由任务本身的单元测试验证. 对于代理性的工作空间任务,Harvey LAB(Harvey AI,2026年)是一个涵盖25个实践领域的法律-工作基准. 它被分为一套固定的演化任务,120项任务和一套纯粹的分散分配,40项任务。 对于工程设计,EngDesign(Guo et al.,2025)贡献了61项设计任务,每个任务由自己的冷冻模拟器而不是法官模型分级. 为了检验其普及能力,我们进一步评估分配外(OO)持有的基准: SWE-bench Verifed(Jimenez等人,2024年)用于固定编码任务的寄存层bug,Job Bench(Li等人,2026年),GDPval(Patwardhan等人,2026年)和APEX-Agents(Vidgen等人,2026年)用于代理工作空间任务,Frontier-Eng(Chi等人,2026年)用于工程设计任务.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against the unevolved base harness H 0 H_{0} that every run starts from, and against four recent harness evolution methods, Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026b ) , AHE ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , TTHE ( Nie et al., 2026 ) and HarnessX ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . All the baselines start from the same H 0 H_{0} and share the frozen policy, the evolve set and the candidate budget. The detailed descriptions of baselines are given in Appendix B .

The proposer, the analyst that writes the cross-round failure feedback and the leakage critic are all Claude Opus 4.8. The base harness we used are Terminus-2 (for coding) ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , a ReAct loop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) over an MCP tool gateway, a dynamic toolbelt ( Vidgen et al., 2026 ) , and ReSum-style context management (for Harvey LAB and EngDesign). Further hyperparameters are given in Appendix D.1 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Figure 3: Main results in all three domains.
blocks.zh: 图3:所有三个领域的主要成果。

blocks.en: RRSI improves every split outside the evolve set, in all three domains. Figure 3 reports every number against the unevolved base harness H 0 H_{0} measured in the same window, so no gain can be attributed to drift in the evaluation infrastructure. The evolve-set gains are 6.0 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 4.9 on EngDesign and 1.1 on Harvey LAB. What matters is what remains once the harness leaves those splits. SWE-bench Verified gains 1.8 points although repository-level bug fixing was never scored. The in-distribution held-out split of Harvey LAB gains 2.3, and the three out-of-distribution agentic benchmarks gain between 3.5 and 4.7 points, 7.2% to 13.1%. Frontier-Eng gains 4.3 Medal points, a 24.3% relative improvement. No held-out split regresses anywhere, which is the failure a memorizing harness produces.

Harvey LAB的内向分配被搁置,收益为2.3,外向分配代理基准的三项收益为3.5至4.7分,占7.2%至13.1%。 Frontier-Eng获得4.3个奖章点,相对提高24.3%。 任何地方都不存在任何被搁置的分裂现象,这就是记忆中的绳索产生的故障。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison with prior harness evolution methods on agentic workspace tasks.
blocks.zh: 表1:关于代理工作空间任务与前期利用演化方法的比较。

blocks.en: RRSI consistently outperforms baselines on all held-out datasets. Table 1 runs the four prior methods from the same H 0 H_{0} on the same evolve split under the same candidate budget. Every one of them works well on evolve set. The performance on in-distribution held-out split is quite similar. The separation appears out of distribution, and there the ranking inverts. Meta-Harness, the strongest baseline on the evolve split, adds 0.9 points to the out-of-distribution average; HarnessX lands on the base one; AHE and TTHE finish below the harness they started from, TTHE by 1.7 points. RRSI posts the smallest evolve-set gain of any evolved harness and the only out-of-distribution average that clears H 0 H_{0} by more than a point, 43.6 against 39.7, which is the trade the regularizers are designed to make.

blocks.en: The transfer is not an artifact of judge-mediated grading or of a shared task format. Harvey LAB, JobBench and GDPval are all scored by a judging model, so a harness could in principle raise its score by writing the way a judge rewards rather than by producing better work. The engineering design instance closes that route: each EngDesign and Frontier-Eng task is graded by its own simulation or testbench, the grading is deterministic, and a design either meets the stated constraints or does not. The gains survive there unchanged, and deterministic grading also removes judge variance from the measurement.
blocks.zh: 移交并非法官调解的定级或共同任务形式的文物。 Harvey LAB,Job Bench和GDPval都通过判断模型获得分数,因此从原则上讲,用绳子可以通过写出法官奖励的方式而不是制作更好的作品来提高分数. 工程设计实例关闭了这条路线:每个EngDesign和Frontier-Eng任务通过自己的模拟或测试台进行分级,分级是决定性的,一个设计要么满足了所声明的限制,要么没有. 收益在那里维持不变,确定等级也消除了衡量中判断的差异。

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析

blocks.en: The main results establish that the evolved harnesses transfer; this section asks what produced that property, whether it depends on the backbone the search was run with, and what it costs. Unless stated otherwise, every run below uses the agentic workspace instance and shares the base harness, policy, evolve split, round count and candidate budget of the main experiment, so that arms differ only in the factor under study.
blocks.zh: 主要结果确定进化的牵引物转移;本节询问产生该物业的原因,它是否取决于搜索所使用的主干,以及它的成本. 除非另有说明,否则下方的每一次运行都使用代理工作空间实例,共享主要实验的底盘、政策、进化、圆计数和候选预算,因此武器仅在研究中的因素上有所不同。

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study of the regularizers on agentic workspace tasks. OOD Avg. is the mean over JobBench, GDPval and APEX-Agents.
blocks.zh: 表2:关于正则剂工作空间任务的研究. OOD Avg.是比Job Bench, GDPval和APEX-Agents更卑鄙的.

blocks.en: Ablation Analysis. We ablate the two groups of regularizers, (i) the proposal-side constraints and (ii) the acceptance-side constraints. As shown in Table 2 , removing either group raises the evolve-set score and lowers transfer. Without the acceptance constraints the evolve-set score rises from 90.5 to 91.5 while the out-of-distribution average falls from 43.6 to 41.0 and token cost rises by half, showing that an unconstrained selection rule spends most of its accepted edits on noise and on context rather than on mechanism. Removing the proposal constraints costs only 0.2 points on the evolve split but 1.7 out of distribution, suggesting that steering where the search looks matters even when nothing is rejected. The most significant degradation comes from removing both, which lifts the evolve-set score to 92.8, the highest of any arm, and leaves the out-of-distribution average at 40.3, within a point of the unevolved harness, at 3.80 million tokens per trial against our 2.42.
blocks.zh: 校勘分析. 我们减少两类常态化者,(一)提案方限制和(二)接受方限制。 如表2所示,删除其中任一组会提高进化设定的分数并降低转录. 没有接受限制,进化设定的分数从90.5升至91.5,而分配外的平均分数从43.6降至41.0,象征性成本上升了一半,表明不加限制的选择规则将其大部分已接受的编辑用于噪音和上下文而不是机制。 取消这项提议只花费0.2分,但分配结果却差1.7分,这表明,即使没有任何东西遭到拒绝,搜索的视线仍然很重要。 最显著的退化来自移除两者,使进化定分升至92.8,是任何手臂中最高的,在未演化的牵引点内,将分配外平均分数保持在40.3,每试一次为380万令令令牌,比照我们的2.42.

blocks.en: Table 3: Policy robustness in the coding domain. Harness evolution is run independently with each frozen policy on Terminal-Bench, and the harness is evaluated unchanged on SWE-bench Verified.
blocks.zh: 表3:编码领域的政策稳健性。 Harness演化在终端-Bench上与每个冷冻政策独立运行,在SWE-bench验证上对机身进行无变化的评价.

blocks.en: RRSI is not tied to one policy family. To test whether the gains from regularized harness evolution depend on the policy used during search, we independently run the coding evolution with two policy models from different families: Claude Opus 4.8 and Gemini 3.5 Flash ( Google, 2026b ) . For each policy, we start from the same coding harness, evolve only on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and evaluate the resulting harness on both the evolve benchmark and SWE-bench Verified. As shown in Table 3 , under Gemini 3.5 Flash, RRSI improves Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 64.6 to 78.7 and transfers a 2.2-point gain to SWE-bench Verified. Under Claude Opus 4.8 the pattern is the same: Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises from 74.2 to 80.2 and SWE-bench Verified from 82.0 to 83.8, although the stronger policy starts closer to the ceiling of both suites and leaves less room to gain. In both cases the harness improves the unseen benchmark without ever being scored on it, which suggests that the benefits of RRSI are not specific to a particular backbone.
blocks.zh: RRSI与一个政策家庭无关。 为了检验正规化的拉带进化的收益是否取决于搜索过程中使用的政策,我们用来自不同家庭的两种政策模式独立运行编码进化: Claude Opus 4.8和双子座3.5 Flash (Google, 2026b ). 对于每项政策,我们从同一个编码带开始,只在终端-Bench 2.1上演化,并在演化的基准和SWE-bench验证中评价由此产生的控制。 如表3所示,在双子座3.5 Flash下,RRSI将终端-奔驰2.1从64.6改进为78.7,并将2.2分增益转让给SWE-bench验证器. 在克劳德·奥普斯4.8下,模式相同:终端-奔驰2.1从74.2升至80.2,SWE-bench验证从82.0升至83.8,不过较强的政策开始更接近两套套房的上限,并留下较少的收益空间. 在这两种情况下,这种利用改进了看不见的基准,而从未在基准上打分,这表明RRSI的好处并非具体针对某一骨干。

blocks.en: The evolved harness still helps under a backbone the search never used. A harness is a program, not a set of weights, so a mechanism that helps only the policy it was searched against is an artifact of that policy rather than a reusable one. We take the final harness of the coding run, evolved with Gemini 3.5 Flash, and evaluate it unchanged with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, a smaller model that never took part in the search. As shown in Table 4 , Terminal-Bench 2.1 accuracy rises from 11.2 to 14.6, a 30.4% relative gain against a base score less than a fifth of the search policy’s. The mechanisms therefore do not depend on the capability level they were searched at, although the absolute gain is smaller because a weaker backbone leaves fewer tasks within reach of any harness.
blocks.zh: 进化的绳索仍然帮助在骨干下 搜索从未使用。 牵引装置是一套程序,不是一套权重,所以只帮助它被搜索到的政策的机制是该政策的一件文物,而不是可重复使用的机制. 我们采取编码运行的最终操纵方式,与双子座3.5 Flash一起进化,与双子座3.1 Flash Lite一起不变评价,这个较小的模型从未参与过搜索. 如表4所示,终端-奔驰2.1的精度从11.2升至14.6,与低于搜索政策五分之一的基准分相比,相对收益率为30.4%。 因此,这些机制并不取决于所搜索到的能力水平,尽管绝对收益较小,因为骨干较弱使任务在任何绳索的可及性都更少。

blocks.en: Table 4: Cross-model transfer on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The harness evolved with Gemini 3.5 Flash as the frozen policy is run unchanged with a weaker backbone that never took part in the search.
blocks.zh: 表4:Bench 2.1终端的跨型转移. 由于冷冻政策运行时没有改变,其骨干较弱,从未参与搜索,因此吊带与双子座3.5 Flash一起演化.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Cost of the final harness of each arm, measured on the evolve split of the agentic workspace instance. OOD Avg. is the mean over JobBench, GDPval and APEX-Agents. The shaded region in (a) is everything RRSI dominates: more policy tokens per trial for a lower out-of-distribution average.
blocks.zh: 图4:根据代理工作空间正在演变的分裂情况衡量的每只臂的最后利用成本。 OOD Avg.是比Job Bench, GDPval和APEX-Agents更卑鄙的. 在(a)中,阴影区域是RRSI主导的一切:每次试验的政策标志值要低于分配外平均数。

blocks.en: RRSI produces the lightest harness of any evolved harness. Two regularizers act directly on cost: the L 1 L_{1} -style budget refuses growth that is not paid for when it is proposed, and the pruning rule removes growth that has stopped being paid for since. No prior method carries either constraint, and Figure 4 (a) shows the consequence: all four sit in the region RRSI dominates, spending more policy tokens per trial for a lower out-of-distribution average. AHE is the extreme case, at 3.82 million tokens per trial, 58% more than ours, for 4.4 points less out of distribution. The ordering carries over to trajectory length in Figure 4 (b), where RRSI runs 26.3 steps per trial against 27.3 to 34.6 for the prior methods. No evolved harness is as cheap as H 0 H_{0} , at 1.56 million tokens and 21.2 steps, so evolution does buy part of its gain with test-time compute; the budget decides how much.
blocks.zh: RRSI能产生任何进化的带最轻的带子. 两个常态化者直接对成本采取行动:L 1 LQQ1} - 风格预算拒绝在提出时没有支付的增长,而奔跑规则取消了此后停止支付的增长. 以往的方法都无任何限制,图4(a)显示了结果:四个区域都位于区域资源战略倡议主导地区,每次试验都花费更多的政策代币,以降低分配外平均数。 AHE是极端的情况,每次试时382万令牌,比我们多58%,因为发行量少4.4分. 图4(b)中,订单延续到轨迹长度,RRSI每次试验的步数为26.3级,而以前的方法为27.3至34.6级。 没有进化的牵引力像H 0 H_{0},以156万令牌和21.2步的价格便宜,所以进化确实通过测试时间计算来购买其部分收益;预算决定了多少.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Agent harnesses. The harness, and not only the backbone model, determines what an agent can accomplish: engineering reports from frontier labs describe how prompt structure, tool interfaces, context compaction and recovery logic decide whether a long-running agent finishes a task at all ( Rajasekaran, 2026 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) , and recent analyses argue that harnesses compose and generalize in their own right ( Zhang and Khattab, 2026 ; Weng, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . A well-designed harness can even substitute for scale, recovering much of a larger backbone’s capability at a fraction of the cost ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . This engineering is overwhelmingly manual, and because the best harness is tied to a specific backbone, its cost is paid again with every model release ( Huang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 特工带子。 牵引力,而不仅仅是骨干模型,决定着一个物剂能够实现什么: 来自前沿实验室的工程报告描述了快速结构,工具界面,上下文紧凑和恢复逻辑如何决定一个长期物剂是否完成了一个任务(Rajasekaran, 2026; Lopopolo, 2026),以及最近的分析认为,牵引力可以自行构成和概括(Zhang and Khattab, 2026;Weng, 2026;Wang等人, 2026a). 设计完善的牵引装置甚至可以取代规模,以成本的一小部分恢复更大的骨干能力(Yang等人,2026a)。 这部工程绝大多数是手工的,由于最好的绳索与特定的骨干捆绑在一起,所以其成本在每次模型发布时都会再次支付(Huang等人,2026b.).

blocks.en: Harness evolution. The closest line of work automates that loop: an LLM proposer rewrites the harness and edits are kept if they raise a benchmark score ( Lee et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026a ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Karten et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026b ) , or a single component is evolved, such as skills ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Xia et al., 2026a ) , memory ( Tang et al., 2025 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) or a preference signal over rollouts ( Pan et al., 2026 ) . This inherits both the mechanisms and the risks of self-improving agents that search over their own code under an empirical fitness signal ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Xia et al., 2026c ; Xia et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . Throughout, the search is driven by the score on the suite it optimizes against, with no term for generalization, and the cost is not hypothetical: reported gains often do not survive a change of suite ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026d ) , and delta attribution separates edits that install a reusable mechanism from those that merely fit the evolution tasks ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent work also targets generalization directly, either as an explicit objective of the search ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) or by replacing greedy selection with a diversity-preserving archive over candidate harnesses ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Our contribution is orthogonal to what these methods edit. We keep the same open edit space and instead regularize the search dynamics: credit assigned over the full evolution history, task-specific logic filtered before scoring, and acceptance against a noise-adjusted baseline, so what survives is a mechanism rather than a fit to the evolution suite.
blocks.zh: 运用演化. 最接近的工作线自动循环:LLM提议者重写带和编辑,如果提高基准分数,则保留(Lee等人,2026b;Lin等人,2026a); Nie等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a;Lee等人,2026年a;Karten等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年b),或一个单一成分演化,如技能(杨等人,2026年b;夏等人,2026年a),记忆(唐等人,2025年;欧阳等人,2026年a;刘等人,2026年a;吴等人,2026年),或优于推出的信号(潘等人,2026年). 这既继承了在经验性健身信号下搜索自身密码的自我改进代理人的机制和风险(Zhang等人,2026b; 王等人,2025年;张等人,2026年c;夏等人,2026年c;夏等人,2026年b;黄等人,2026年c;黄等人,2026年a). 在整个过程中,搜索都是由其最优化的套房上的分数驱动,没有概括的术语,成本不是假设的:所报告的收益往往无法在套房变更后幸存(Wang等人,2026b; Huang et al., 2026d ),和 delta 属性将安装可重复使用的机制的编辑与仅仅适合进化任务的编辑区分开来(Ding et al., 2026). 同时期的工作还直接针对泛泛化,要么作为搜索的明确目标(张等人,2026d),要么用保存多样性的档案取代候选绳索(罗等人,2026). 我们的贡献与这些方法编辑的内容是一致的。 我们保留同样的开放编辑空间,转而规范搜索动态:在完整的演化史上分配信用,在打分前过滤特定任务逻辑,以及接受一个噪声调整基线,所以生存下来的是机制而不是适合演化套件.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We study iterative harness evolution as a practical form of recursive self-improvement at the agent-system level, and show that this recursive process itself requires regularization. Because a finite evolve set is reused adaptively across rounds, apparent self-improvement can reflect benchmark-specific fitting, evaluation noise, or unnecessary complexity rather than transferable progress. RRSI addresses this problem by regularizing both proposal and selection while leaving the harness edit space open. Across coding, agentic workspace, and engineering design tasks, the resulting harnesses improve held-out and cross-benchmark performance while using less inference cost than unregularized evolution. These results suggest that making agent systems increasingly capable through recursive self-improvement requires controlling not only what can change, but also how repeated feedback is converted into persistent changes.
blocks.zh: 我们研究迭代利用进化,作为代理系统层面递归自我改进的一种实用形式,并表明这种递归过程本身需要规范化. 由于有限的演化集可按不同轮次进行适应性再利用,明显的自我改进可以反映具体基准的配位、评价噪音或不必要的复杂性,而不是可转移的进展。 RRSI通过使提案和选择规范化,同时让控制器编辑空间打开来解决这个问题. 在整个编码、代理工作空间和工程设计任务中,产生的利用改进了牵引和跨基准性能,同时利用的推论成本低于非常规演化。 这些结果表明,通过递归性自我改进使代理系统的能力日益增强,不仅需要控制什么可以改变,而且需要控制反复反馈如何转化为持续变化。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study focuses on harness-level recursive self-improvement with frozen backbone models, and therefore does not address settings where model weights are updated during evolution. In addition, RRSI still relies on a finite evolve set and several regularization hyperparameters, so its effectiveness may depend on the quality of the feedback signal and the chosen search budget. Finally, although we evaluate transfer across multiple domains, benchmarks, and policy models, broader validation is needed to determine how well the method generalizes to substantially different agent architectures, tool ecosystems, and longer-running self-improvement processes.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究侧重于利用冷冻骨干模型进行牵引级递归自我改进,因此没有涉及在演化过程中更新模型权重的设置. 此外,RRSI仍然依赖于一个有限的进化集和几个规范化的超参数,因此其有效性可能取决于反馈信号的质量以及所选择的搜索预算. 最后,虽然我们评价跨越多个领域、基准和政策模式的转让,但还需要更广泛的验证,以确定这种方法如何很好地概括到实质上不同的代理架构、工具生态系统和长期自我改进过程。

blocks.en: Appendix A Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: This shows how each environment is run and scored. A harness and its baseline are always evaluated in the same window, with the same tool environment, the same judge and the same number of trials.
blocks.zh: 这表明每个环境是如何运行和得分的. 始终在同一窗口评价一个牵引装置及其基线,其工具环境、法官和审判次数相同。

blocks.en: A.1 Terminal-Bench 2.1
blocks.zh: A.1 终点站-奔驰2.1

blocks.en: Each task is a container image with a task description, a working directory and a set of unit tests that are hidden from the agent ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) . The agent drives a real shell through the harness, and a task counts as solved only if the task’s own test suite passes after the agent stops, so the reward is exact and cannot be produced by a plausible-looking answer. The reported accuracy is the fraction of the 89 tasks solved in this way. Containers are torn down and rebuilt between arms so that no state carries from one evaluation to the next.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都是一个容器图像,并附有任务说明,工作目录和一套隐藏在代理物上的单位测试(Merrill等人,2026年). 只有当任务本身的测试套间在任务停止后通过时, 任务才算算完成, 因此奖励是准确的, 报告的准确性是以这种方式解决的89项任务的一小部分. 集装箱被拆卸,在武器之间重建,因此没有任何国家从一个评价到下一个评价。

blocks.en: A.2 SWE-bench Verified
blocks.zh: A.2 SWE-bench 验证

blocks.en: Each instance is a real GitHub issue paired with the repository snapshot at the time of the report ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . The agent must produce a patch, which is then applied to the snapshot and checked against the instance’s fail-to-pass tests, which must go from failing to passing, and its pass-to-pass tests, which must remain passing. The reported resolve rate is the fraction of instances that satisfy both conditions.
blocks.zh: 每个实例都是真实的GitHub问题, 代理商必须制作一个补丁,然后将补丁应用到快照上,并对照该实例的故障通过测试(必须从失败到通过)及其通过测试(必须一直通过)进行检查。 所报告的解决率是满足这两个条件的事例的一小部分。

blocks.en: A.3 Harvey LAB
blocks.zh: A.3 哈维·拉布

blocks.en: Each task provides a folder of source documents in Word, Excel and PDF form and requires the agent to produce deliverable files under exact requested filenames ( Harvey AI, 2026 ) , which are graded by a strict per-criterion rubric of 20 to 100 independently judged criteria per task, roughly 14,000 criterion verdicts per full evaluation. A criterion is judged in isolation by an LLM judge (Gemini-3.5-Flash ( Google, 2026b ) ) that reads the produced deliverable together with that single criterion, and the score of a run is the fraction of criteria passed over all tasks, so a task with a long rubric contributes proportionally more evidence than a short one and a missing deliverable fails every criterion it was supposed to satisfy rather than being dropped. The 160 tasks are partitioned once into a 120-task evolve set and a 40-task held-out set, and the partition is fixed for the experiment.
blocks.zh: 每个任务提供Word,Excel和PDF格式的源文件文件夹,并要求代理商在确切要求的文件名下生成可交付的文件(Harvey AI, 2026 ),这些文件按每个任务20到100个独立判断的标准严格按标准进行分级,每个完全评价大约14000个标准判断. 一个标准由LLM法官(Gemini-3.5-Flash (Google, 2026b))孤立地判断,该法官将生产的可交付品与该单一标准一并解读,运行的得分是在所有任务中传递的标准的分数,因此一个长标题的任务比短标题贡献了比例上更多的证据,而缺失的可交付品则未能满足而不是被放弃的每一项标准. 160项任务一度被分割为120任务演化组和40任务搁置组,分区被固定用于实验.

blocks.en: A.4 JobBench
blocks.zh: A.4 乔布本奇

blocks.en: Tasks are drawn from real professional workflows ( Li et al., 2026 ) , each shipping a task folder of input files and a wrapper prompt, with the reference material the agent would need to look up deliberately withheld so that part of the work is genuine retrieval. The harness exposes a filesystem, a code execution tool for producing office and PDF deliverables, and a grounded web search tool. Deliverables are graded by the benchmark’s own weighted rubric, and the reported number is the weighted rubric score over the evaluated split. We use an LLM judge (average score of Gemini-3.5-Flash and Claude Opus 4.8).
blocks.zh: 任务来自真实的专业工作流程(Li et al., 2026),每封任务文件夹包含一个输入文件以及一个包装提示,而代理商需要查找的参考材料会刻意扣留,这样部分工作才是真正的检索. 该套带暴露出一个文件系统,一个用于制作办公室和PDF可交付内容的代码执行工具,以及一个被定位的网络搜索工具. 可交付品按基准本身的加权分数进行分级,报告的数字是加权分数与评价分数的比值。 我们使用LLM裁判(双子座3.5-Flash和克劳德·奥普斯4.8的平均得分).

blocks.en: A.5 GDPval
blocks.zh: A.5 国内生产总值

blocks.en: For each task the deliverable produced by the harness is placed side by side with the human expert deliverable shipped with the benchmark ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) , a panel of three judges of different provenance picks the better of the two, and the reported number is the win rate against the expert over 185 tasks. The panel combines an open-weight model served locally (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) ) with two proprietary models from different vendors (Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) and Gemini-3.1 Pro ( Google, 2026a ) ), each pair is judged in both presentation orders to remove position bias, and the verdict for a task is the majority vote of the three. Each judge therefore issues 204 comparisons per harness, and a win rate above 50% means the harness produces the preferred deliverable more often than the human expert it is compared against.
blocks.zh: 就每项任务而言,牵引装置产生的可交付品与基准运送的人类专家可交付品(Patwardhan等人,2026年)并列,由来自不同地点的三名法官组成的小组挑选出两者中较好的,所报告的数字是185项任务对专家的胜利率。 板块结合了本地服务的一种开放重量型号(Quen3.6-35B-A3B(Quen Team,2026))和来自不同供应商的两种专有型号. (Claude Sonnet 4.6(Anthropic, 2026b)和双子座-3.1 Pro(Google, 2026a)),每对子在两个演示命令中都进行判断,以消除位置偏差,任务的判决是三人的多数票. 因此,每位法官发布204个比对,超过50%的胜率意味着比人类专家更经常地生产首选的交付品。

blocks.en: A.6 APEX-Agents
blocks.zh: A.6 APEX-代理人

blocks.en: Each task places the agent in a sandboxed world with its own MCP tool surface, covering a filesystem, PDF reading, spreadsheets, mail, chat, calendar, documents and code execution, and spanning three professional domains ( Vidgen et al., 2026 ) . A task is graded by a per-task rubric judged by an LLM judge (Gemini-3.5-Flash), and a task counts as a success under pass@1 only when its rubric is satisfied on the single sampled rollout. We evaluate the full set of 480 tasks and always report over that full denominator, so a task whose rollout is missing because of an infrastructure failure counts as a failure rather than being excluded, which prevents a harness that crashes on hard worlds from looking better than one that attempts them.
blocks.zh: 每个任务将代理放在一个沙盒世界中,它有自己的MCP工具表面,覆盖一个文件系统,PDF读取,电子表格,邮件,聊天,日历,文件和代码执行,并跨越三个专业领域(Vidgen等人,2026年). 一个任务由一个LLM法官(Gemini-3.5-Flash)判断的每个任务标题进行分级,一个任务只有在其标题在单一的抽样推出上得到满足时才算成通过@1下的成功. 我们评估了一整套480项任务,并且总是报告这些全部分母的情况,因此,由于基础设施的故障而未能展开的任务算不上是失败,而不是被排除在外,这使得在困难世界上崩溃的绳子不能比试图这样做的绳子更好看。

blocks.en: A.7 EngDesign
blocks.zh: A.7 设计

blocks.en: We used the license-free subset of EngDesign ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , of which we take the 61 tasks that run without proprietary simulators. Each task states a design goal together with the physical constraints the design must satisfy, and each is graded by its own frozen simulation or testbench rather than by a judge model, so grading is deterministic and every point of variance we measure comes from the policy. Evolution runs on all 61 tasks with no in-distribution held-out split, since the suite is too small to spend tasks on one.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了EngDeign的无许可证子集(Guo等人,2025年),其中我们承担了无专利模拟器运行的61项任务. 每个任务都规定了一个设计目标,加上设计必须满足的物理限制,每个任务都按自己的冷冻模拟或测试台进行分级,而不是按判断模型进行分级,所以分级是决定性的,我们衡量的每个差异点都来自政策. 由于套房太小,无法将任务花在一个套房上,因此演化会贯穿于所有61项任务上,没有被搁置分配。

blocks.en: A.8 Frontier-Eng
blocks.zh: A.8 边境工程

blocks.en: Frontier-Eng ( Chi et al., 2026 ) collects real-world engineering optimization problems from 26 domains. Each task asks the agent to produce a design or a program that is scored by a frozen task-specific simulator or evaluator on a continuous objective, so as with EngDesign no judge model is involved and grading is deterministic. Because the objectives are not commensurable across tasks, the benchmark reports a Medal Score: for each task the three best feasible results of the frozen v1 snapshot are the gold, silver and bronze thresholds, a submission earns 1, 0.67 or 0.33 for reaching each, and the score is the mean credit over the 47 tasks of the v1 set, which we report as a percentage. We use Frontier-Eng only as an out-of-distribution test surface. Its EngDesign domain reuses tasks from our evolve set and is excluded, and tasks whose evaluation environment could not be built in our sandbox receive no credit in either arm, so 38 of the 47 tasks contribute credit and both arms are scored on exactly the same tasks.
blocks.zh: Frontier-Eng(Chi等人,2026年)从26个域收集现实世界工程优化问题. 每项任务都要求代理人制作一个设计或程序,在连续目标上由被冻结的任务特定模拟器或评估器打分,这样,对于EngDesign公司来说,没有法官模型参与,分级是决定性的. 由于目标不能在任务之间相互对应,基准报告一个奖章分数:对于每项任务,冷冻v1快照的三个最佳可行结果是金,银和青铜阈值,提交单达到每个值的得分是1,0.67或0.33,而得分则是在v1集47项任务中的平均得分,我们以百分比报告. 我们只使用Frontier-Eng作为分配外试验表面. 它的EngDesign域再利用我们演化的一组任务,被排除在外,而那些无法在我们的沙盒中构建评价环境的任务,在两个臂中都没有获得任何功劳,因此47项任务中有38项贡献功劳,两个臂都得到完全相同的任务的得分.

blocks.en: Appendix B Baseline Methods
blocks.zh: 附录B 方法

blocks.en: We briefly summarize the four harness-evolution baselines used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们简要总结了我们实验中使用的四条利用演进基线。

blocks.en:
Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026b ) .
Meta-Harness formulates harness engineering as an outer-loop optimization problem over executable harness code. Its agentic proposer has access to the source code, evaluation scores, and execution traces of previous candidates, and uses this accumulated experience to propose improved harnesses.
blocks.zh:
Meta-Harness (Lee等人, 2026b ).
Meta-Harness将拉带工程设计成比可执行的拉带代码更优化的外部拉带问题. 它的代理求婚者可以访问源代码,评价分数,以及以前候选人的行刑痕迹,并利用这一积累的经验提出改进的利用.

blocks.en:
Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE) ( Lin et al., 2026a ) .
AHE uses an observability-driven evolution loop for coding-agent harnesses. It organizes harness components, execution experience, and edit outcomes into explicit representations so that an evolving agent can diagnose failures, propose changes, and evaluate the effects of previous edits.
blocks.zh:
代理哈内斯工程(AHE)(Lin等人,2026a).
AHE使用可观察性驱动的进化循环,用于编码剂的牵引. 它组织利用组件,执行经验,并将结果编辑成明确的表示,这样一个不断发展的代理可以诊断失败,提出修改,并评价之前编辑的效果.

blocks.en:
Test-Time Harness Evolution (TTHE) ( Nie et al., 2026 ) .
TTHE evolves executable harnesses during test-time adaptation while keeping the underlying model weights fixed. It maintains multiple candidate harnesses, proposes modifications from execution traces, and uses an agentic judge to select a harness that persists to subsequent inputs.
blocks.zh:
试验-时间利用演化(TTHE)(Nie等人,2026年).
TTHE在测试-时间适应时会演化可执行带,同时保持基本模型权重固定. 它保持多种候选工具,建议修改执行痕迹,并使用代理法官来选择一种长期坚持其后的投入。

blocks.en:
HarnessX ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
HarnessX represents an agent harness as a composition of modular, typed primitives spanning components such as prompts, tools, memory, and control flow. Its trace-driven adaptation mechanism uses execution feedback to modify and select harness configurations, enabling the runtime scaffold to evolve over time.
blocks.zh:
HarnessX (陈等, 2026).
调和 X代表一种代理牵引装置,它由模块化的,打字的原始人组成,它们跨越了诸如提示,工具,内存,控制流等组件. 其微量驱动的适应机制使用执行反馈来修改和选择拉带配置,使运行时间脚手架随时间演变.

blocks.en: RRSI introduces a small number of hyperparameters that control update sparsity, exploration, pruning, and the cost–performance trade-off. The noise tolerance δ \delta is calibrated from repeated evaluations of the unchanged base harness. The edit-budget parameters ( b min , b max ) (b_{\min},b_{\max}) determine how many independent changes can be bundled into one candidate, while w w and m draft m_{\mathrm{draft}} control when and how strongly the search explores underused components. blocks.en: These examples provide a more concrete view of the regularization behavior. In particular, the two candidates from the first coding round are superficially similar, yet only the candidate with a sufficiently large measured improvement survives the cost-aware selection rule. Conversely, the round-8 candidate reduces inference cost but is still rejected because its performance falls below the admissible floor. The engineering example shows the complementary case: a small and reusable control-flow correction is retained with little resource growth. Together, these trajectories suggest that RRSI does not simply accumulate edits that improve the evolve-set score, but selectively retains changes whose measured benefit is sufficiently robust relative to their complexity.
blocks.zh: 这些例子为规范化行为提供了更具体的看法. 特别是,第一轮编码回合的两名候选人表面上相似,但只有经过足够大程度的衡量改进的候选人才符合成本意识甄选规则。 相反,第8轮候选人减少了推论费用,但仍被拒绝,因为其业绩低于可接受的底线。 该工程实例显示了一个互补的例子:一个小的且可重复使用的控制流修正被保留,资源增长很少. 这些轨迹加在一起表明RRSI并不仅仅累积可以改善进化设定分数的编辑,而是有选择地保留其计量收益与其复杂性相比足够强劲的变化.
